data.description: Main dataset containing 10,000 synthetic global job market records from 2024 to 2026. Covers 30 job titles, 15 industries, 15 countries, and 32 features including compensation, satisfaction, AI adoption, work model, and hiring patterns.
data.name: job_market_salary_trends.csv

columns.name: job_id
columns.description: Unique job record identifier in format JOB000001 to JOB010000.

columns.name: year
columns.description: Year of the job posting or survey record. Values: 2024, 2025, 2026.

columns.name: quarter
columns.description: Quarter of the year for the job record. Values: Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4.

columns.name: job_title
columns.description: Specific professional job title such as Software Engineer, Data Scientist, or Product Manager.

columns.name: job_category
columns.description: Broad occupational category. Values: Tech & Engineering, Data & AI, Design & Creative, Business & Management, Finance & Legal, Marketing & Sales, Operations & HR.

columns.name: industry
columns.description: Industry sector of the employer. 15 sectors including Technology, Finance & Banking, Healthcare, Education, E-commerce, and more.

columns.name: country
columns.description: Country where the job is located. 15 countries including USA, UK, Germany, India, Pakistan, UAE, and more.

columns.name: experience_level
columns.description: Seniority level of the role. Values: Entry Level (0-2 yrs), Junior (2-4 yrs), Mid-level (4-7 yrs), Senior (7-12 yrs), Lead/Principal (12+ yrs).

columns.name: years_of_experience
columns.description: Total years of professional work experience. Range: 0 to 25.

columns.name: education_level
columns.description: Highest educational qualification. Values: High School, Associate Degree, Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, PhD, Bootcamp/Self-taught.

columns.name: employment_type
columns.description: Nature of the employment contract. Values: Full-time, Part-time, Contract, Freelance, Remote Full-time.

columns.name: work_model
columns.description: Physical work arrangement. Values: On-site, Remote, Hybrid.

columns.name: company_size
columns.description: Size of the hiring company by employee count. Values: Startup (1-50), Small (51-200), Medium (201-1000), Large (1001-5000), Enterprise (5000+).

columns.name: salary_usd_annual
columns.description: Annual base salary normalized to USD for cross-country comparison. Does not include bonuses or equity.

columns.name: salary_local_currency
columns.description: Annual salary expressed in the local currency of the job location.

columns.name: currency
columns.description: ISO 4217 currency code for the local salary. Examples: USD, GBP, EUR, INR, PKR, AED, SGD.

columns.name: primary_skills
columns.description: Main technical or professional skill set associated with the role. Examples: Python/SQL/ML, JavaScript/React, AWS/Docker/Terraform.

columns.name: required_skills_count
columns.description: Number of distinct skills listed as required for the position. Range: 2 to 8.

columns.name: benefits_score
columns.description: Employer benefits quality score rated by the employee on a scale of 1 (Very Poor) to 10 (Excellent).

columns.name: job_satisfaction
columns.description: Overall job satisfaction reported by the employee. Values: Very Dissatisfied, Dissatisfied, Neutral, Satisfied, Very Satisfied.

columns.name: salary_satisfaction
columns.description: Employee satisfaction with their compensation. Values: Very Dissatisfied, Dissatisfied, Neutral, Satisfied, Very Satisfied.

columns.name: work_life_balance_score
columns.description: Self-rated work-life balance score on a scale of 1 (Very Poor) to 10 (Excellent).

columns.name: career_growth_score
columns.description: Perceived career advancement opportunities rated on a scale of 1 (Very Poor) to 10 (Excellent).

columns.name: remote_work_preference
columns.description: Employee preference for remote work. Values: Strongly Prefer Remote, Prefer Remote, No Preference, Prefer On-site, Strongly Prefer On-site.

columns.name: ai_tools_usage
columns.description: Frequency of AI tools usage in daily work. Values: Never, Rarely, Sometimes, Often, Daily.

columns.name: automation_risk_level
columns.description: Assessed risk level of the job role being automated. Values: Very Low, Low, Medium, High, Very High.

columns.name: visa_sponsorship_available
columns.description: Whether the employer offers visa sponsorship for the role. Values: Yes, No.

columns.name: gender
columns.description: Gender identity of the job holder. Values: Male, Female, Non-binary, Prefer not to say.

columns.name: age_group
columns.description: Age bracket of the job holder. Values: 18-24, 25-34, 35-44, 45-54, 55+.

columns.name: certifications_count
columns.description: Number of professional certifications held by the employee. Range: 0 to 10.

columns.name: job_posting_platform
columns.description: Platform or channel where the job was posted or found. Values: LinkedIn, Indeed, Glassdoor, Company Website, Referral, Kaggle Jobs, Other.

columns.name: hiring_time_days
columns.description: Number of days from job posting to offer acceptance. Range: 3 to 180 days.

data.description: Full dataset documentation including schema, use cases, salary methodology, research questions, citation, and author information.
data.name: README.md
